A Very Long Job Title on an Employee

User manual · English · 5 steps
Learn how a very long text in the job title field behaves on the employee form, without saving anything.

1. Open Employees

Open the Employees app.

2. New

Click New to start an employee.

3. Type a long job title

Type a very long job title, about 100 characters, then press Tab.

4. Check the field

Look at the field. Click it to continue.

5. Discard

Click the discard icon to leave without saving.
